title: Technology Sector Update for 09/19/2018: BABA,INTC,BIDU,SPLK

Technology stocks were significantly softer in Wednesday trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 losing nearly 0.6% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was dropping about 0.2%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Alibaba ( BABA ) pushed out to a more than 4% gain on Wednesday after saying its cloud-services unit was partnering with chip-making giant Intel ( INTC ) on digital broadcasts from the upcoming 2020 summer Olympics in Tokyo. The companies expect to launch the cloud-based Olympic Broadcasting Services in two years using Intel's Xeon scalable processors while Alibaba will concentrate on a more efficient and reliable delivery of media from the XXXII Games to broadcasters worldwide.
In other sector news:
(+) Baidu ( BIDU ) put up a more than 4% at one point on Wednesday after the Chinese technology company it was collaborating with Wabco Holdings ( WBC ) to develop braking control systems for self-driving commercial vehicles. The companies expect to combine and adapt Baidu's Apollo autonomous driving software platform with Wabco's open source, self-driving platform to create advanced technologies for the commercial vehicle industry.
(-) Splunk ( SPLK ) dropped over 2% on Wednesday after the big-data analytics company overnight priced an upsized $1.85 billion private placement of its 0.50% convertible senior notes due 2023 and 1.125% convertible senior notes due 2025. The company placed $1.1 billion of the five-year convertible notes, up from its original plan to offer $850 million of the notes, while it trimmed the number of seven-year convertible notes it eventually sold to $750 million.
